title: 第15章 多出三位圣体必须要给江渊找道侣越多越好第16章 老祖要绑来圣地圣女帝女
slug: 多子多福家族帮我攻略极品仙子
lines: 命令一出，整个江家高层再次被惊动。
没过多久，三位气宇轩昂的年轻人，便被带到了祖地外围的一处封闭大殿。
底蕴老祖们一旦踏出祖地就会飞速流逝生命，
所以他们不到万不得已不会离开。
为首的正是江毅，身材魁梧，眼神锐利如刀，天生剑骨。
另外两人，一个是赤发男子，周身燃烧着淡淡的不灭神火，正是拥有焚天神体的江炎。
还有一人是位女子，眉心有道紫色月牙印记，名叫江月，拥有太阴神体。
“拜见家主，拜见帝子!”
三人齐齐躬身行礼。
江战没有废话，直接说道:“今日召你们前来，是为了一件大事。”
他伸手从储物戒中取出两枚升灵丹，递给江炎和江月。
“这是帝子赐予你二人的丹药，服下吧。”
江炎和江月对视一眼，虽然不明所以，但还是遵命接过丹药。
“至于你…”江战看向江毅，眼中闪过一丝复杂，“江毅，你最后服下。”
“是。”江毅退至一旁。
而另一边，江炎和江月对视一眼后，也服下各自的升灵丹。
下一秒——
整个江家祖地，猛然间爆发出两道冲天神光!
江炎身上的不灭神火瞬间暴涨百倍，由赤红色转变为近乎纯白，温度高到连虚空都开始融化!
他的身体开始蜕变，皮肤上浮现出一道道如同大道烙印般的火焰纹路，每一道纹路都蕴含着毁天灭地的力量!
江炎发出痛苦的嘶吼，整个人如同一颗燃烧的小太阳!
“守住心神，引导药力，与你的焚天神体本源相合！”
“你的神体，正在向着更高的层次跃迁，这是你的劫，也是你的缘！”
火焰中，江炎听到了江战的引导，嘶吼声渐渐停歇。
轰！
一道无比璀璨的金色神光，从他的天灵盖冲天而起，直接洞穿了这片混沌空间，仿佛要将整个江家祖地都给捅个窟窿！
紧接着，一轮巨大的金色太阳虚影，在他身后缓缓浮现！
那太阳之中，仿佛有金乌在啼鸣，有神殿在沉浮，散发着一股焚天煮海，霸绝寰宇的恐怖气息！
“这是……九阳焚天圣体！”
一位对体质颇有研究的帝境老祖发出一声惊呼，意志中充满了难以置信的震撼！
“没错，焚天神体的进化形态之一！传说中，此圣体大成，可化身为真正的太阳星辰，一念之间便可焚尽九天十地，连寻常大帝都要退避三舍！”
“天呐！真的成功了！一枚丹药，真的造就了一尊圣体！”
“不可思议！这简直是万古未有的奇迹！”
沉睡了无数万年的帝境老祖们，在这一刻，彻底失态了！
他们的意志在混沌中剧烈地波动着，掀起了滔天巨浪！
圣体！
一尊活生生的圣体，就在他们眼前诞生了！
这对他们的冲击，实在是太大了！
要知道，就算是他们江家，也不是每一代都有圣体的。
需要天时地利人和。
content_en:
As soon as the order was issued, the entire Jiang family's senior management was alarmed again.
Not long after, the three impressive young men were taken to a closed hall outside the ancestral land.
It is understood that once the ancestors step out of their ancestral land, their lives will pass quickly.
So they won't leave unless they have to.
The leader was none other than Jiang Yi, who was tall and tall, with eyes as sharp as knives and a natural sword bone.
The other two people, one is a red-haired man with a faint immortal fire burning all over his body, it is Jiang Yan who has the Burning Sky Divine Body.
There is another person who is a woman with a purple crescent mark between her eyebrows. Her name is Jiang Yue and she possesses the divine body of Taiyin.
"Greetings to the master of the family and the emperor's son!"
The three of them bowed and saluted.
Jiang Zhan said without any nonsense, "I've called you here today for a big event."
He reached out and took out two Spirit Ascension Pills from the storage ring and handed them to Jiang Yan and Jiang Yue.
"This is the elixir given to you two by the emperor. Take it."
Jiang Yan and Jiang Yue looked at each other. Although they didn't know why, they still accepted the elixir as ordered.
"As for you..." Jiang Zhan looked at Jiang Yi, a hint of complexity flashed in his eyes, "Jiang Yi, you finally surrender."
"Yes." Jiang Yi stepped aside.
On the other side, Jiang Yan and Jiang Yue looked at each other and took their respective spiritual elixirs.
The next second——
Boom!!!
The entire Jiang family ancestral land suddenly erupted into two divine lights!
The immortal fire on Jiang Yan instantly increased a hundred times, changing from red to almost pure white, and the temperature was so high that even the void began to melt!
His body began to transform, and flame lines like the brand of the great road appeared on his skin. Each line contained the power to destroy the world!
"Ahhhh——!"
Jiang Yan roared in pain, his whole body was like a burning little sun!
"Keep your mind, guide the power of the medicine, and be in harmony with the origin of your Burning Sky Divine Body!"
"Your divine body is leaping to a higher level. This is your calamity and your fate!"
In the flames, Jiang Yan heard Jiang Zhan's guidance, and the roar gradually stopped.
boom!
An extremely bright golden divine light soared into the sky from his Heavenly Spirit Cap, directly piercing through this chaotic space, as if it was going to poke a hole in the entire Jiang family ancestral land!
Immediately afterwards, a huge golden shadow of the sun slowly emerged behind him!
In the sun, there seemed to be a golden crow crowing, a temple rising and falling, exuding a terrifying aura that burned the sky and boiled the sea, dominating the world!
"This is... the Nine Yang Burning Heaven Holy Body!"
An Imperial Realm ancestor who had extensive research on physical constitution exclaimed, his will filled with incredible shock!
"That's right, one of the evolved forms of the Burning Heaven Divine Body! According to legend, this holy body can be transformed into real suns and stars. It can burn nine heavens and ten places with just one thought, and even ordinary emperors would retreat!"
"Oh my God! It really worked! One pill really created a holy body!"
"Incredible! This is simply an unprecedented miracle!"
The ancestors of the Imperial Realm who had been sleeping for countless thousands of years completely lost their composure at this moment!
Their wills fluctuated violently in the chaos, setting off huge waves!
Eucharist!
A living holy body was born right before their eyes!
This had a huge impact on them!
You know, even in their Jiang family, not every generation has a holy body.
It takes the right time, right place and right people.
title_en: Chapter 15: There are three more holy bodies. The more Taoist companions must be found for Jiang Yuan, the better. Chapter 16: The ancestor wants to kidnap the Holy Land Saint and the Emperor.
